basic_info.description: Welcome to your dream home! Located in the sought-after Westwood Park neighborhood, this stunningly updated six-bedroom, four-bathroom residence offers a bright, open floor plan perfect for modern living. The spacious living room features large bay windows that flood the space with natural light, while the sleek, contemporary kitchen is designed for both style and function. The main level is home to three bedrooms and two bathrooms, including a luxurious primary suite. Downstairs, you'll find three more bedrooms, one en-suite, two additional bathrooms, a flexible space and a convenient laundry room. Step outside to a beautifully landscaped backyard, complete with serene seating areas and mature trees, ideal for relaxation and entertaining. Additional features include a one-car garage with EV charging and tandem driveway parking for extra convenience. With easy access to shopping, dining, public transportation, and freeways, this home truly offers the best of both comfort and location.
